findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before allowing document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`. This removes the function’s previous tenant-equality guard and permits cross-tenant document reads wherever this exported authorization function is used.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document-read authorization
findings.body:
Any caller supplying different `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values now receives `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access wherever this exported authorization function guards reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality check before allowing document reads
findings.body:
For any `userTenant` different from `documentTenant`, the function now returns `true`, breaking the exported cross-tenant data-boundary contract and allowing callers to treat another tenant’s document as readable.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
